definition.H_at_k: canonical dataset-traced-object PID occurs in the same canonicalized named recorded top-k ranking
definition.P_at_k: canonical selected-object PID occurs in the canonicalized named recorded top-k ranking
definition.canonical_object_identity: zero-based passage PID in the exact frozen links.jsonl resolver
definition.scope: retrospective deterministic accounting on frozen rankings; no new reader outcome, causal claim, or deployment prevalence claim
definition.subset: valid selector outputs whose selected and dataset-traced IDs both resolve to distinct passage PIDs under the frozen resolver

denominators_and_dependence.dependence_warning: pooled counts are descriptive: 329 model-question rows come from 160 questions, and rows sharing a question ID are not independent

executor_order_and_pairwise_comparisons.interpretation_boundary: At k=5 and k=20 the BM25-to-final-reranker contrast has the same direction under P and H, matching 6/10 and 7/10 executor pairs, respectively. At k=1 its directions disagree, as do 7/10 pairs. The headline is therefore a valid pairwise contrast, not a claim that P and H induce the same complete executor ordering.
executor_order_and_pairwise_comparisons.orientation: pairwise gaps are left_stack minus right_stack; each metric sign therefore describes the left executor relative to the right

sign_disagreement_effect_magnitudes.interpretation_boundary: These are descriptive absolute gaps for the 14 sign-disagreeing cells in the complete frozen grid. They do not estimate reversal prevalence or practical deployment impact.

inputs.container_policy: bind exact scientific member bytes, not the outer ZIP

result_scope.protocol_and_analysis_scope: The frozen prompt defines selected_link as one exact shown Wikipedia key whose page passage was needed. The configurations bind its decoded-label query, the body-only BM25 baseline, BGE-M3, ColBERTv2, hybrid RRF, the final hybrid reranker, output depth 20, and report cutoffs 1/5/20. The selected-object top-k obligation and mismatch-specific P/H join belong to the paper's later profile evaluation, which is applied retrospectively to the frozen rankings.
result_scope.sensitivity_comparison_family_declared: all four neural/hybrid retrievers x three hosted-model families x three traced-passage-recall cutoffs, with BM25 recorded as the baseline in the same release

protocol_binding.temporal_evidence_boundary: The protocol records and pre-result commit declaration are hash-bound. The exact rankings are inputs to this deterministic join; the release does not claim an independently authenticated wall-clock timestamp for the later P/H analysis.
